narrative.overview:
The store is the descent from a plane window. The first viewport is a rounded full-screen window onto a real flight clip, and the whole page is that sky seen while scrolling: the window opens as the visitor scrolls and the clip advances (60 frames drawn on a fixed canvas, scrubbed by scroll). Sections after the hero flow directly over the moving sky, with white headings and no boxes.

Density is low and mobile first. One cool light ground carries the interior pages; the sky is the signature of the home. Color is strict: night and royal blue for structure, white for surfaces, and the yellow of the logo's "Voe" as the single warm accent.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed canvas backdrop scrubbed by scroll, clipped to a rounded window that opens with scroll; static first frame when reduced motion is requested.
Pill-shaped controls everywhere; containers at 1.25rem or 2rem radius.
Display type in Bricolage Grotesque 600 with tight tracking; body in Hanken Grotesk.
Depth by soft blue-tinted shadows and the photographic sky, never by hard offsets.
AA contrast, 44px touch targets, 3px blue focus ring.

rules.name: The Single Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the logo's colour and the one warm voice; it appears on the search action and highlighted hero words, never as a background for large areas or as a second CTA colour.

rules.name: The Night On Yellow Rule
rules.body: Any text on yellow is night navy (#0b1b45); white on yellow fails contrast.

rules.name: The Display Is Display Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is for titles, prices and tile labels; never for buttons, fields or body copy.

rules.name: The Dim Before Text Rule
rules.body: Any white text placed over the sky relies on the navy dim layer plus a text shadow; do not remove either.

dos: Do keep sections flowing over the sky on the home, with white headings and no boxed panels.
Do use pills for every interactive control and 1.25rem for content containers.
Do put night navy text on yellow and white text over the dimmed sky.
Do keep touch targets at least 2.75rem and the 3px focus ring.
Do respect reduced motion: show the first frame still, no scrubbing.
donts: Don't put the search form in a white card on a flat colour block; it floats at the window's foot.
Don't use yellow for anything beyond the logo, hero emphasis and the search action.
Don't use hard offset shadows, glyph icons or invented testimonials, numbers or destination photos.
Don't set Bricolage on controls or body text.
